title: Taaqeh derret yan silaal
intro: Atu caylale dumaahih doolatih cokmih buxal soltaah, caylale miraacini inkih tan ummattal degelta axcuk sinni yaybeleeleqeh yan. ta miraacah xaqut soolah yan taama abeyna, amoytiinuk kaxxa niya luk amaanat le. itta luk, oson ekraariseenih, ken miraacisuh ruube farmoytih takkaawisso cineenih. Atu tama aamanti le taama abeynit miyyak sugtem baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu elle waaram caylale doolatay caylale num miraacisam inkih tan ummattal rabbiino inta.
Anu ta amoytak kibal le malaak akkuk ayfaf eceeh, ken fayxi kee amri quukah.
Yallih farmoyti ni baaxo nummah nee yaabisak yemeete waqdi, yi-ammoyta kee yoo yaabbeenim cinne.
Anu kaxxa gira ursaanam kee kaxxa xisneh kallayto xaaa massoosaanam amrisen.
Yi amoyti fayyale rikkisso ugusam faxak suge too fayya sinnih qaran gufaanam.
ellecaboh, yi mirac, ni qande, kee yoo wonnah fiyneeh, baddi addat cule.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Konnabna le amoytiinuu kee qibaadah wale

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
